transcript_asr_prefill: 前方两百米右转进入人民路
transcript_annotator_a: 前方两百米右转进入人民路
transcript_gold: 前方两百米右转进入人民路
rationale_en: Intra-word boundary offset of 10 ms is within the 30 ms tolerance; agreement is locked and no edit is warranted. Both raters correctly passed it.
rationale_zh: 句中词边界偏移 10ms，在 30ms 容差内；agreement 已锁定，无需改动。两名标注员均正确放行。

transcript_asr_prefill: 您好请问有什么可以帮您
transcript_annotator_a: 您好请问有什么可以帮您
transcript_gold: 您好请问有什么可以帮您
rationale_en: Utterance-edge start/end offset of 20 ms is within the 50 ms edge tolerance; boundary is accepted unchanged.
rationale_zh: 句首句尾起止边界偏移 20ms，在 50ms 首尾容差内；边界原样放行。

transcript_asr_prefill: 沪深两市今日小幅收涨
transcript_annotator_a: 沪深两市今日小幅收涨
transcript_gold: 沪深两市今日小幅收涨
rationale_en: Short-pause bridge deviation of 10 ms is inside the 30 ms tolerance; the minor gap is verified Other and may be retained within R<=3.
rationale_zh: 跨短停顿桥接偏差 10ms，在 30ms 容差内；minor gap 为经核实的 Other，可在 R<=3 内保留。

transcript_asr_prefill: 请描述一下您最近的症状
transcript_annotator_a: 请描述一下您最近的症状
transcript_gold: 请描述一下您最近的症状
rationale_en: Tail end boundary is truncated by 115 ms, far beyond the 50 ms edge tolerance; the boundary must be extended to the reference end.
rationale_zh: 句尾吞音截断 115ms，远超 50ms 首尾容差；必须延长边界至参考终点。

transcript_asr_prefill: 我已经等了很久了请尽快处理
transcript_annotator_a: 我已经等了很久请尽快处理
transcript_gold: 我已经等了很久了请尽快处理
rationale_en: Rater A dragged the slice boundary to erase a minor short-segment Other warning, which broke an adjacent already-aligned agreement word boundary and raised the disagreement count past the R<=3 retention cap. Under D009 (disagreement-first) this is a one-vote veto violation; retain the agreement boundary and the verified Other.
rationale_zh: 标注员 A 为消除次要 short-segment 告警而拖动切片边界，破坏了相邻已对齐的 agreement 词边界，并使 disagreement 计数超过 R<=3 保留上限。按 D009 分歧优先铁律构成一票否决违规；应保住 agreement 边界并保留经核实的 Other。

transcript_asr_prefill: 前方路口向左转
transcript_annotator_a: 前方路口向左转
transcript_gold: 前方路口向左转
rationale_en: Removing the 140 ms minor gap would disturb the locked agreement boundary; D009 requires keeping agreement and retaining the verified Other (count 2 <= 3).
rationale_zh: 消除 140ms minor gap 会扰动已锁定的 agreement 边界；按 D009 应保住 agreement，保留经核实的 Other（计数 2<=3）。

transcript_asr_prefill: 您的订单已经发货请注意查收
transcript_annotator_a: 您的订单已经发货注意查收
transcript_gold: 您的订单已经发货请注意查收
rationale_en: Rater A split a long segment by shifting the boundary, destroying adjacent agreement boundaries and pushing disagreement above the retention limit; D009 disagreement-first makes this a veto.
rationale_zh: 标注员 A 为切分长片段而平移边界，破坏相邻 agreement 边界并使 disagreement 超过保留上限；按 D009 分歧优先构成一票否决。

transcript_asr_prefill: 涨幅百分之三点五
transcript_gold: 涨幅百分之三点五
rationale_en: The number was actually spoken as words; transcribing as 3.5% is an unauthorized standardization. Restore the literal pronunciation.
rationale_zh: 该数字实际以汉字读出，转写为 3.5% 属擅自标准化改写；应按实际发音还原逐字稿。

transcript_asr_prefill: 我们用 Python 写的
transcript_annotator_a: 我们用派森写的
transcript_gold: 我们用 Python 写的
rationale_en: Code-switching must keep the original Latin token and case; phonetic transliteration to a Chinese word is a transcript error.
rationale_zh: 中英代码混读须保留原始拉丁词形与大小写；音译成中文词属转写错误。

transcript_asr_prefill: 建议服用氯雷他定
transcript_annotator_a: 建议服用绿雷他定
transcript_gold: 建议服用氯雷他定
rationale_en: The ASR prefill is only a locating anchor; the annotator guessed a homophone by fluency and changed the drug name. Never invent syllables not actually uttered. Restore the literal term.
rationale_zh: ASR 预填仅作定位锚点；标注员按通顺度脑补同音字改写了药名。严禁凭上下文猜测实际未发出的音节；应还原原词。

transcript_asr_prefill: （哼唱）
transcript_annotator_a: （哼唱）
transcript_gold: （哼唱）
rationale_en: Humming/background singing is correctly tagged and the edge offset is within tolerance; no change required.
rationale_zh: 哼唱/背景歌声标签正确，边界偏移在容差内；无需改动。

scenario: 真实双人重叠语音切分
transcript_asr_prefill: （说话人甲）好的 （说话人乙）我来说
transcript_annotator_a: 好的我来说
transcript_gold: （说话人甲）好的 |（说话人乙）我来说
rationale_en: Two voices genuinely overlap in time; merging them into one stream loses the true overlap. Restore millisecond-level split boundaries and the overlap flag.
rationale_zh: 两人语音在时间上真实重叠；合并成单流会丢失 true overlap。应恢复毫秒级切分边界与 overlap 标记。

transcript_asr_prefill: （甲）你先说（乙）不你先说
transcript_annotator_a: （甲）你先说（乙）不你先说
transcript_gold: （甲）你先说（乙）不你先说
rationale_en: The turns are adjacent zero-gap turn-taking, not true overlap; set the boundary at the handoff and keep overlap=false.
rationale_zh: 两轮为零间隙相邻抢话而非真实重叠；在交接点设定边界并保持 overlap=false。

transcript_asr_prefill: 总共一百二十三元五角
transcript_gold: 总共一百二十三元五角
rationale_en: Amounts must be transcribed as actually pronounced; converting to Arabic numerals is an unauthorized rewrite.
rationale_zh: 金额须按实际发音转写；改写为阿拉伯数字属擅自标准化。

scenario: 车载导航自然人声混入TTS播报
transcript_asr_prefill: （人声）导航去机场 （TTS）前方路况拥堵
transcript_annotator_a: （人声）导航去机场 （TTS）前方路况拥堵
transcript_gold: （人声）导航去机场 （TTS）前方路况拥堵
rationale_en: Because a real target human speaker is present, the recording-level synthetic flag must be false even though TTS broadcast is mixed in; marking the whole recording synthetic:true would scrap the entire utterance. Keep the transcript and correct the flag.
rationale_zh: 只要存在真实目标自然人说话，即便混入 TTS 播报，录音级 synthetic 必须为 false；标成 true 会导致整段语料报废。应保留逐字稿并修正问卷标记。

transcript_asr_prefill: （甲声）你怎么来了（乙声）我路过
transcript_annotator_a: （甲声）你怎么来了（乙声）我路过
transcript_gold: （甲声）你怎么来了（乙声）我路过
rationale_en: A single speaker imitating multiple voices is one physical speaker; multiSpeaker must be false, distinct from a genuine second person.
rationale_zh: 单人模仿多角声线属同一物理说话人；multiSpeaker 应为 false，与真实第二人区分。

scenario: 远场背景真实第二人插话
transcript_asr_prefill: （近场）好的 （远场背景）等一下
transcript_annotator_a: （近场）好的 （远场背景）等一下
transcript_gold: （近场）好的 （远场背景）等一下
rationale_en: A genuine far-field second speaker intervenes, so multiSpeaker must be true; this is not voice imitation.
rationale_zh: 存在远场背景真实第二人插话，multiSpeaker 应为 true；此非声线模仿。

transcript_asr_prefill: 欢迎使用智能语音服务
transcript_annotator_a: 欢迎使用智能语音服务
transcript_gold: 欢迎使用智能语音服务
rationale_en: This is a purely synthetic TTS segment with no human speaker, so synthetic:true is correct and the boundary is within tolerance.
rationale_zh: 本条为纯合成 TTS 片段、无自然人说话，synthetic:true 正确，边界在容差内，无需改动。

scenario: 智能客服相邻抢话问卷边界
transcript_asr_prefill: （坐席）请稍等（客户）我有急事
transcript_annotator_a: （坐席）请稍等（客户）我有急事
transcript_gold: （坐席）请稍等（客户）我有急事
rationale_en: The speakers are distinct but adjacent with no genuine temporal overlap; overlap must be false while multiSpeaker stays true.
rationale_zh: 说话人不同但为相邻抢话、无真实时间重叠；overlap 应为 false，multiSpeaker 保持 true。

transcript_asr_prefill: 本月销售额环比增长百分之八
transcript_annotator_a: 本月销售额环比增长百分之八
transcript_gold: 本月销售额环比增长百分之八
rationale_en: The minor gap is verified Other within tolerance; removing it would risk the locked agreement boundary, so retain it (count 2 <= 3).
rationale_zh: minor gap 为容差内经核实的 Other；消除它会危及已锁定的 agreement 边界，故保留（计数 2<=3）。
